laden.claim: Everything that can break — and the spares to match!
laden.erstes_mal: First visit! Remember this shop: when your toothbrush breaks, the Goobyman has new ones.
laden.pflaster_heute: Already patched up today. Come back tomorrow!

zahnputz.blockiert: The brush is done for! The Goobyman in town has new ones.
zahnputz.neue_buerste: New brush locked in — back to scrubbing!

bruch_info.text: Happens to the best of us. The GOOBYMAN shop in town sells new toothbrushes — Fluff and Turbo last longer.

umhang.gag: FIVE items?! That's a job for … GOOBYMAN!
umhang.pose: *strikes a pose with a billowing towel*
